description: Desktop email, calendar, contacts and task manager
pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $payload -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Agenoras nested app-64.7z payload was not found in the NSIS extraction.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'Agenoras.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Could not extract the Agenoras application payload.' }

$launcherContent = [string]::Join([Environment]::NewLine, @('@echo off', 'setlocal', 'set "APPDATA=%~dp0data\Roaming"', 'set "LOCALAPPDATA=%~dp0data\Local"', 'if not exist "%APPDATA%" mkdir "%APPDATA%"', 'if not exist "%LOCALAPPDATA%" mkdir "%LOCALAPPDATA%"', 'start "" /D "%~dp0" "%~dp0Agenoras.exe" %*', ''))
notes: The official Windows release is an NSIS installer containing a nested app-64.7z archive. Scoop extracts both layers with 7-Zip; the installer is not executed.
Electron stores settings and user data in its default userData directory under %APPDATA%\Agenoras; this data remains outside the Scoop application directory.
The original NSIS installer registers Agenoras as a Windows mail app and mailto protocol handler. This portable manifest intentionally does not write those registry associations.
